messages:
Sam W: Hey team — just opened my first PR but CI failed on linting. Where's the style guide and any first-PR checklist? TL;DR: what's expected for branch naming, commit message format, and reviewers? Thanks!
Harper Li: welcome! :wave: style guide is in repo root: docs/STYLE.md. Branching: feature/<ticket>-short-desc. Commits: imperative, one-sentence summary, mention JIRA. Reviewers: add 2 reviewers: one from eng + one from product if UI changes.
Sam W: thanks! quick Q: pre-commit hooks failing locally. Error: "black found?" Here's what I ran:
Sam W: ```
pip install -r dev-requirements.txt
pre-commit install
pre-commit run --all-files
```
Sam W: then I get "error: cannot import name 'toml'" when running pre-commit
DevEx Bot: Hi Sam W — onboarding checklist: https://redwood.dev/onboarding-pr (internal). Also open a ticket in #help if setup blockers persist. :robot_face: 
Harper Li: try `pip install 'pre-commit>=2.20' toml` and ensure python 3.10 venv activated. We pin tools via pyproject.toml; run `python -m pip install -r dev-requirements.txt` inside venv.
Lee (eng): tip: small commits + descriptive PR body. Use the PR template — it prompts for test steps, rollout plan, and perf impact. If lint keeps flaking, add `skip ci` only after consulting infra.
Sam W: got it, installing toml now. One more: is it okay to include generated protobufs in the PR? Or should I open a separate proto-gen PR?
Harper Li: separate PR for generated files is preferred, but for tiny changes you can include them if you call it out in the PR description. Mention `proto-gen` and tag infra.
Sam W: awesome, will update and re-run. thanks y'all :pray:
Harper Li: ping me if CI still fails, I can pair for 10-15m. :calendar:
Lee (eng): welcome aboard again! :tada:
